purpose: Matched single-factor detail-loss trial: test whether final-head texture can improve without changing ordinary pixels/shadows or relying on overall HDR error.
change: Add equal-image signed-asinh RGB gradient squared error on adjacent valid highlight pixels. Same v7 initialization, frozen body/restorer/source correction, scene sampler/seed/batch4/crop192/600 updates/Adam0.0001 as equal-image control. No radiance clamp; artificial crop borders excluded.
acceptance: Retain original legacy/coherent evaluation checks and record failures. Apply same colour constraint after evaluation, then require coherent H error no worse than constrained equal-image control and fully-clipped/highlight log-gradient errors no worse than analytic. Grade -3/0/+3 EV errors reported separately, all must pass previous registered nonregression checks before adoption. No promotion based on one improved metric.
